seed: Exact shared R1 warm seed used by R2; disclose TRAIN-label-selected history; never call a retained seed a new LLM proposal
fitness: Official minimization objective = numpy.round(-float(exact equal-family complete-schedule reward/total-weight),5); equal-objective dedup retains first current-population identity; quality alone ranks population
work: Exact equal-family feature-plus-repair work is feedback/reporting only; no fitness tie-break or parent/winner selection
parent_selection: With replacement, probability proportional to1/(one-based-rank+current_population_size); e1/e2 two parents, other mutation operators one
local_driver: One native CLI request, then immutable request/result transaction to the server and manual verified fitness ingestion before the next dependent request; no autonomous SSH credential handling
feedback: Parent thought/program and complete-schedule quality/work/errors only; no conditional labels, fit, gate, equality joins or cycles
failures: Every original position retained; no retries/replacements/extra candidates; malformed/failed calls have absent measured fitness; empty population stays failed
attribution: Same-start warm-seed incremental pipeline comparison; four separate fixed authoring blocks, not an isolated causal witness or model-population comparison
budget_scope: 32 maximum single-candidate author calls; 36 maximum evaluations including four prescribed seed evaluations; unmatched calls/tokens/time transparent
TEST: No access before separately frozen four nonguarded baseline identities and root TEST release; a new performance version may add them without changing existing R2 roles or barrier
